entities.name: L-23 Super Blaník
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The LET L-23 Super Blaník is a two-seat, all-metal structure glider with fabric covered control surfaces. The aircraft is primarily used for flight training; its single-seat sister model is the Let L-33 Solo.
